enriched_activities.desc: Lies down on bed. Closes eyes. Sleeps. Turns to left side. Pulls blanket up. Sleeps. Turns to right side. Adjusts pillow. Sleeps. Stretches legs. Sleeps. Opens eyes briefly. Closes eyes. Turns over. Sleeps. Continues sleeping until alarm.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth, and taking a hot shower
enriched_activities.desc: Wakes up. Sits up. Stands up. Walks to bathroom. Turns on light and water heater. Takes off clothes and steps into shower. Turns on shower. Washes body with soap. Rinses body. Turns off shower. Steps out. Dries body with towel. Walks to sink. Turns on tap. Washes face with face wash. Rinses face. Brushes teeth and rinses mouth. Turns off tap. Wipes face. Turns off light. Walks out.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast, boiling water with the kettle and toasting bread
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to kitchen. Opens refrigerator. Takes out eggs, milk, and butter. Closes refrigerator. Fills kettle with water and turns it on. Places bread in toaster and presses lever. Kettle boils. Pours hot water into cup and adds tea bag. Toaster pops. Takes bread out, places on plate, and spreads butter. Cracks eggs into bowl and whisks. Turns on induction cooker. Places pan on cooker. Pours oil and eggs into pan. Scrambles eggs. Turns off cooker and places eggs on plate. Sits at table. Eats breakfast. Drinks tea. Clears plate.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and packing work bag for the day
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bedroom. Opens wardrobe. Takes out shirt. Puts on shirt. Takes out pants. Puts on pants. Takes out socks. Puts on socks. Takes out shoes. Puts on shoes. Walks to desk. Opens bag. Places laptop in bag. Places notebook in bag. Places pen in bag. Zips bag. Picks up bag. Walks out of bedroom.
Walks to bus stop. Waits for bus. Bus arrives. Steps onto bus. Taps card. Finds seat. Sits down. Looks out window. Checks phone. Puts phone away. Gets off bus. Walks to office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the nonprofit office: coordinating community programs, answering emails, and meeting partner organizations
enriched_activities.desc: Arrives at office. Greets colleagues. Sits at desk. Turns on computer. Opens email. Reads and replies to emails. Makes phone calls. Meets with partner organization. Discusses program details and takes notes. Returns to desk. Works on computer. Attends meeting and takes minutes. Returns to desk. Makes calls and sends emails. Organizes documents. Prints materials. Files documents. Takes break. Returns to desk.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break and eating lunch near the office
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to café. Orders food. Pays. Waits for food. Takes tray. Finds table. Sits down. Eats lunch. Drinks water. Cleans table. Returns tray. Walks back to office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working at the nonprofit office: planning upcoming community events and preparing program materials
enriched_activities.desc: Sits at desk. Opens event planning document. Reviews plans. Contacts vendors. Sends emails. Makes phone calls. Prepares materials. Prints flyers. Assembles packets. Meets with team. Discusses event logistics. Takes notes. Updates schedule. Sends follow-up emails. Organizes files. Checks calendar. Prepares for next day.
Walks to bus stop. Waits for bus. Bus arrives. Steps on bus. Taps card. Finds seat. Sits down. Checks phone. Puts phone away. Gets off bus. Walks home.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner with the induction cooker and eating dinner
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to kitchen. Opens refrigerator. Takes out vegetables and meat. Closes refrigerator. Washes and cuts vegetables. Cuts meat. Turns on induction cooker. Places pan on cooker. Pours oil. Adds meat and stirs. Adds vegetables and stirs. Adds seasoning. Covers pan and waits. Turns off cooker. Serves food on plate. Sits at table. Eats dinner. Drinks water. Clears table.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing and putting away dishes and wiping down the kitchen counter
enriched_activities.desc: Takes dishes to sink. Turns on tap. Adds dish soap. Scrubs dishes. Rinses dishes. Places dishes in drying rack. Dries dishes with towel. Opens cabinet. Places dishes in cabinet. Wipes counter with cloth. Turns off tap. Washes hands. Dries hands.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa, watching TV and browsing the phone
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to living room. Sits on sofa. Picks up remote. Turns on TV. Changes channels. Puts down remote. Picks up phone. Browses phone. Watches TV. Picks up remote. Changes channel. Puts down remote. Continues watching TV. Picks up phone. Checks messages. Puts down phone. Watches TV. Stands up. Walks to kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing a light snack and setting out items for tomorrow's breakfast
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to kitchen. Opens refrigerator. Takes out yogurt and fruit. Closes refrigerator. Takes bowl from cabinet. Opens yogurt. Spoons yogurt into bowl. Cuts fruit. Adds fruit to bowl. Eats snack. Places bowl in sink. Opens cabinet. Takes out cereal. Takes out bowl. Places cereal box on counter. Takes out milk. Places milk on counter. Sets out spoon. Closes cabinet. Walks out.

enriched_activities.activity: Using the computer under the desk lamp to review tomorrow's program schedule and reading before bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bedroom. Sits at desk. Turns on desk lamp. Opens computer. Turns on computer. Opens program schedule. Reviews schedule. Makes notes. Closes program schedule. Opens e-book. Reads. Turns page. Continues reading. Closes e-book. Turns off computer. Turns off desk lamp. Stands up. Walks to bed.

Lies down on bed. Closes eyes. Sleeps. Turns to left side. Pulls blanket up. Sleeps. Turns to right side. Adjusts pillow. Sleeps. Stretches legs. Sleeps. Opens eyes briefly. Closes eyes. Turns over. Sleeps. Continues sleeping.
